selection_rule: Exact behavioral_failure / (PASS + valid behavioral_failure), descending; ties by valid trial count descending, then case_id ascending. All available conditions pooled and also reported separately. Duplicate run receipts folded only when full decoded JSON is identical and execution timestamp is present. Infrastructure/contamination/unscored records excluded from denominator; case variants not collapsed into source families.
condition_counts: Columns contain behavioral failures / valid trials, not passes.
